title: Sri Lanka with Sigiriya and Ella: Kandy to Bentota in Seven Days
alt: Ravana Falls tumbling beside the road near Ella
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Seven days from the hills to the sea on a sensible budget: two nights in Kandy with Sigiriya and the dance show, a night each in the tea country and in Ella, a night on the beach at Bentota with the turtles, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 6 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary and Kandy sightseeing; the upper lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; the Tooth Relic temple and an excursion to Sigiriya; sightseeing tours of Nuwara Eliya and Ella; Bentota sightseeing with the turtle hatchery and fish spa; the Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
